text.arabic_uthmani: ۞ مَّثَلُ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ٱلَّتِى وُعِدَ ٱلْمُتَّقُونَ ۖ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ ۖ أُكُلُهَا دَآئِمٌۭ وَظِلُّهَا ۚ تِلْكَ عُقْبَى ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوا۟ ۖ وَّعُقْبَى ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ ٱلنَّارُ

words.gloss_range: likeness, model, or description opening a structured garden frame
words.root_gloss_range: standing forth, likeness, representation, example, and comparison; local noun selects a descriptive model rather than simple equality
words.prose: {{ar:مَثَلُ}} ({{tr:mathalu}}) opens with a likeness-model rather than the garden directly, so the reader is asked to process a structured description, not a claim of equal counterpart, before the final verdict. Its construct with {{ar:ٱلْجَنَّةِ}} ({{tr:al-jannati}}) ties the model to the known promised garden, while the disputed predicate relation makes the following river clause carry real descriptive weight. The singular noun also keeps the whole scene one concentrated template, even though the broader formula has a cross-reference at 47:15 and the surah-local parable field reaches back to 13:17.

topics.headline: construct likeness-model
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah begins with a model of the garden, not a detached proverb or direct place-name.
topics.reason: Construct grammar and lexical evidence support reading the opening as a garden-specific likeness or description.

topics.headline: compressed predicate frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the following description must do predicate work because the opening subject is syntactically compressed.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence allows the river clause to describe the opening phrase, while the exact predicate analysis remains debated.

topics.headline: formula and boundary frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opening model gathers earlier parable language and moves toward the closing outcome-word.
topics.reason: Cross-references and boundary rows are useful as echoes, but they do not override the local construct grammar.

topics.headline: singular template against plural pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the received singular makes the whole description one stable template rather than many separate likenesses.
topics.reason: The variant pressure is apparatus-level contrast; the local surface remains the singular noun.

words.gloss_range: the definite promised garden as sheltered, productive enclosure
words.root_gloss_range: concealment, enclosure, garden, shielding, and hiddenness; local context selects the promised garden while retaining sheltering enclosure pressure
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْجَنَّةِ}} ({{tr:al-jannati}}) is genitive under {{ar:مَثَلُ}} ({{tr:mathalu}}), so the garden specifies the likeness rather than becoming the first subject by itself. Its definiteness presumes a known promised garden, and the root’s concealment-enclosure field is locally realized through beneathness, rivers, produce, and shade. The later beneath-it, its-produce, and its-shade phrases route their pronouns back to this garden, so the singular form holds the benefits inside one integrated promised enclosure while the recurring garden-river formula gives the scene recognizable eschatological force.

topics.headline: known garden in construct
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the garden is a known referent governed by the opening likeness, not an independent new subject.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence force the genitive construct relation and support the definite referent.

topics.headline: sheltered enclosure image
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the garden as a protected enclosure, not merely vegetation or a generic landscape.
topics.reason: The broader concealment root is narrowed by rivers, produce, and shade to the promised garden as sheltering enclosure.

topics.headline: formulaic scene-core
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that later pronouns and attributes all return to this garden as the middle scene’s architectural center.
topics.reason: Local pronoun routing and formula evidence support the garden as the scene-core.

words.gloss_range: feminine singular relative pronoun binding the promise clause to the garden
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّتِى}} ({{tr:allatī}}) locks the promise clause to {{ar:ٱلْجَنَّةِ}} ({{tr:al-jannati}}) by feminine singular agreement. It makes {{ar:وُعِدَ}} ({{tr:wuʿida}}) and its recipient phrase a modifier of the garden, not a fresh sentence, so the place is identified by promise-recipient relation before its rivers and benefits are shown.

topics.headline: relative promise-lock
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the promised status belongs to the garden before the scenery begins.
topics.reason: Agreement and attachment evidence force the relative clause to modify the garden.

words.gloss_range: settled passive promise inside the garden-defining relative clause
words.root_gloss_range: promise, threat, appointment, and committed future; local garden-recipient frame selects favorable promise
words.prose: {{ar:وُعِدَ}} ({{tr:wuʿida}}) is passive perfect, so the promise is treated as established while the promiser is not named in the clause. That passive foregrounds {{ar:ٱلْمُتَّقُونَ}} ({{tr:al-muttaqūna}}) as recipients, and the broader commitment root is narrowed here to favorable promise because the object-field is the garden. The same passive garden-promise construction has a concrete parallel at 47:15, and the root returns from promise language in 13:31 into this positive guarantee.

topics.headline: settled passive guarantee
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the garden is described as the content of an already settled guarantee.
topics.reason: QAC grammar confirms passive perfect with the following nominative passive subject.

topics.headline: commitment root narrowed to promise
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the same root can carry threat, but here garden and recipient context select promise.
topics.reason: Lexical range survives as binary background but is locally narrowed by the positive garden frame.

topics.headline: promise-garden formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the passive promise construction belongs to an eschatological garden formula, including 47:15.
topics.reason: Concrete cross-reference and same-surah recurrence support formulaic provenance.

words.gloss_range: defined human self-guarding class receiving the promise
words.root_gloss_range: guarding, shielding, protection, and self-protection; local Form VIII participle selects reflexive self-guarding identity
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْمُتَّقُونَ}} ({{tr:al-muttaqūna}}) is the human plural passive subject of {{ar:وُعِدَ}} ({{tr:wuʿida}}), so the promise is routed to a defined class. Its Form VIII participial shape keeps agency inside the recipients: they are self-guarders, not merely people carrying a piety label. The same protection root returns in {{ar:ٱتَّقَوا۟}} ({{tr:ittaqaw}}) at the verdict point, turning identity into completed action and answering the prior denial of external protection in 13:34.

topics.headline: human promise-recipient class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the promised recipients are a human class, not the garden or an abstract quality.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the word as the passive subject of the promise verb.

topics.headline: Form VIII self-shielding identity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that taqwā is framed as active self-shielding within the word’s form.
topics.reason: The broad protection field is narrowed by the Form VIII active participle to reflexive self-guarding.

topics.headline: identity echoed as completed action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah’s arc from named self-guarders to people who actually self-guarded, with 13:34 as boundary foil.
topics.reason: The intra-ayah root echo and boundary evidence preserve this payoff.

words.gloss_range: ongoing river-flow in the garden formula
words.root_gloss_range: flowing, running, proceeding, occurring, and routed course; local rivers select literal flow with process-pressure from imperfect aspect
words.prose: {{ar:تَجْرِى}} ({{tr:tajrī}}) uses the imperfect, so the garden’s rivers are pictured as ongoing motion rather than a completed event. The verb comes before the source phrase and delayed subject, making the listener hear movement from beneath before {{ar:ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ}} ({{tr:al-anhāru}}) lands as the visible resolution. The root can also mean to proceed or happen, but the river subject keeps literal water-flow primary while leaving the sense of a continuously operating garden system; its same-surah return from controlled cosmic running in 13:2 makes paradise part of that ordered-motion field.

topics.headline: ongoing flow aspect
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices motion as a continuing state of the garden, not a one-time event.
topics.reason: Imperfect Form I grammar supports ongoing, non-causative flow.

topics.headline: literal flow with process pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices directed water movement, while broader process senses remain secondary.
topics.reason: The river subject narrows the root to literal flow; aspect and root range preserve process pressure.

topics.headline: subject-delayed paradise formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the formulaic sequence where motion and source precede the named rivers.
topics.reason: Attachment and formula evidence support the delayed-subject payoff.

words.gloss_range: source preposition governing the garden’s underside
words.prose: {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}) makes the phrase a source relation: the rivers flow from beneath the garden, not merely inside it or below it. By standing between the flow verb and the delayed rivers, the particle makes the hidden underside audible as the generative layer of the scene.

topics.headline: source-layer preposition
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that beneathness functions as origin for the flow, not bare location.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence confirms the preposition governs the locative complement as source/origin.

words.gloss_range: the garden’s own underside as source-layer for the rivers
words.root_gloss_range: below, underside, lower place, and beneathness; local suffixed locative selects one garden-owned substrate
words.prose: {{ar:تَحْتِهَا}} ({{tr:taḥtihā}}) fuses beneathness with a feminine suffix that routes the source back to the garden. Governed by {{ar:مِن}} ({{tr:min}}), it turns the garden into a layered place: visible enclosure above and a hidden substrate below from which the rivers run. The singular locative keeps that underside unified rather than scattered into multiple lower places.

topics.headline: owned underside substrate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the garden has its own hidden lower layer feeding the scene.
topics.reason: Suffix reference, prepositional government, and locative semantics converge on one garden-owned substrate.

topics.headline: beneath-rivers formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this underside belongs to the recognizable beneath-rivers paradise formula.
topics.reason: Co-occurrence and exact-form recurrence support formula provenance.

words.gloss_range: the definite rivers resolving the ongoing beneath-flow clause
words.root_gloss_range: river, abundant flow, daytime spread, and forceful outpouring; local formula selects rivers while retaining abundance pressure
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْأَنْهَٰرُ}} ({{tr:al-anhāru}}) arrives after the verb and source phrase as the delayed nominative subject, resolving the motion already set in motion by {{ar:تَجْرِى}} ({{tr:tajrī}}). Its definite broken plural gives the garden a known class of rivers rather than one incidental stream. The root’s river and daylight/outpouring field is narrowed to watercourses here, but it intensifies the rivers as abundant, open flow inside a fixed paradise formula.

topics.headline: delayed subject resolution
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the rivers as the final reveal of a clause that began with motion.
topics.reason: QAC grammar and agreement evidence identify the noun as delayed subject.

topics.headline: definite river class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a familiar class of paradise rivers, not an isolated water feature.
topics.reason: Definiteness, plurality, and formula recurrence support this payoff.

topics.headline: abundant outpouring pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices abundance in the river image while the local subject keeps the sense from becoming rebuke or daylight.
topics.reason: The root range is narrowed by the garden-flow frame.

words.gloss_range: the garden’s own non-depleting produce or yield
words.root_gloss_range: eating, consuming, corroding, produce, and yield; local suffixed noun selects garden provision under permanence
words.prose: {{ar:أُكُلُهَا}} ({{tr:ukuluhā}}) is the subject of a verbless permanence claim, so the garden’s produce is presented as an inherent state, not a timed event. The suffix makes it the garden’s own yield, and {{ar:دَآئِمٌ}} ({{tr:dāʾimun}}) blocks the consumption-root from implying depletion. The accepted lightened reading affects syllable weight, not the sense or syntactic role, while the pairing with shade makes provision and shelter share one permanence claim.

topics.headline: possessed produce in nominal clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the produce as the garden’s own enduring attribute, not generic food.
topics.reason: Nominal predication and suffix evidence support possessed, inherent provision.

topics.headline: consumption root turned into non-depleting yield
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a consumption-root made safe by permanence: what is consumed does not run out.
topics.reason: The root’s consuming and corrosive range is narrowed by the garden-yield noun and permanence predicate.

topics.headline: variant and paired permanence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that recitational variation leaves the provision claim intact, and the predicate extends toward shade.
topics.reason: Variant rows are narrowed to phonetic/prosodic payoff; coordination evidence preserves the paired predicate.

words.gloss_range: rare continuity predicate shared by produce and shade
words.root_gloss_range: lasting, remaining, continuing, and being uninterrupted; local active participle selects ongoing non-depletion rather than abstract eternity vocabulary
words.prose: {{ar:دَآئِمٌ}} ({{tr:dāʾimun}}) predicates unbroken continuity first over {{ar:أُكُلُهَا}} ({{tr:ukuluhā}}) and then, through coordination, over {{ar:ظِلُّهَا}} ({{tr:ẓilluhā}}). The active participle makes permanence a continuing quality, and its rarity marks a deliberate choice for non-depleting provision rather than default eternity language. The medial hamza creates an audible hold inside the long word, so the sound briefly arrests the very continuity it names. One predicate therefore does double duty: the garden’s nourishment and shelter both persist.

topics.headline: one permanence predicate for two benefits
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices one continuity word governing both food and shade.
topics.reason: Attachment and coordination evidence support the shared predicate.

topics.headline: rare continuity not generic eternity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the lexical choice emphasizes uninterrupted provision rather than merely abstract endlessness.
topics.reason: Distribution evidence and lexical contrast narrow the root to continuity/non-depletion.

topics.headline: active participle and acoustic hold
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices permanence as an ongoing quality whose medial hamza gives the word an audible hold.
topics.reason: Form evidence and sound row support the word-level payoff without changing the sense.

words.gloss_range: coordinating particle adding shade under the same permanence claim
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) joins shade to produce under the same permanence predicate. The particle keeps the two benefits distinct while letting one claim cover both, so the garden’s provision becomes comprehensive across nourishment and shelter rather than a single collapsed item.

topics.headline: paired benefits under one predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that food and shade are coordinated as two benefits sharing one permanence claim.
topics.reason: Coordination and attachment evidence support predicate sharing without appositional collapse.

words.gloss_range: the garden’s possessed shade sharing permanence with its produce
words.root_gloss_range: shade, covering, and remaining in a state; local noun selects sheltering shade with persistence pressure from the shared predicate
words.prose: {{ar:ظِلُّهَا}} ({{tr:ẓilluhā}}) is the garden’s own shade by suffix, parallel to its own produce. It inherits {{ar:دَآئِمٌ}} ({{tr:dāʾimun}}) through coordination, so shelter is as permanent as sustenance. The root’s link between shade and remaining strengthens the image of durable cover, and its same-surah return from created shadows in 13:15 moves the field into promised shelter. Cross-references such as 56:43-44 show that not every shade is comforting; this one is garden shade.

topics.headline: possessed shade with shared predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices shade as a specific property of the garden sharing the same permanence as produce.
topics.reason: Suffix and coordination evidence confirm possession and predicate inheritance.

topics.headline: shelter completes sustenance
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the scene covers both intake and protective comfort.
topics.reason: Semantic pairing with produce preserves the two-axis garden benefit.

topics.headline: shade and remaining pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices durable shelter, while contrastive smoke-shade references do not control the local positive sense.
topics.reason: Root and intertext evidence are narrowed by the local garden context and shared permanence predicate.

words.gloss_range: demonstrative pivot turning the garden scene into verdict
words.prose: {{ar:تِلْكَ}} ({{tr:tilka}}) gathers the preceding garden description and points it into the outcome clause. Its feminine singular form fits the verdict noun and the garden scene, making the described scene identifiable as {{ar:عُقْبَى}} ({{tr:ʿuqbā}}) rather than leaving it as imagery only. As a pivot, it also lets the positive scene answer the punishment foil from 13:34.

topics.headline: demonstrative verdict pivot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the turn from description to evaluative outcome.
topics.reason: Demonstrative grammar and boundary evidence support a backward-gathering and forward-predicating pivot.

words.gloss_range: consequence or sequel assigned to those who self-guarded
words.root_gloss_range: heel, following, sequel, consequence, and punishment; local noun selects terminal outcome while remaining value-neutral until class and predicate fill it
words.prose: {{ar:عُقْبَى}} ({{tr:ʿuqbā}}) names the garden scene as a consequence, the thing that follows a life-pattern. In the first clause it predicates {{ar:تِلْكَ}} ({{tr:tilka}}) and governs {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}), assigning the outcome to those defined by self-guarding. Because the same word returns for the deniers, the noun itself stays value-neutral; the contrast comes from the possessor and final content. Surah-local occurrences at 13:22, 13:24, and 13:42 make consequence a dominant thread around this verdict.

topics.headline: outcome assigned by construct
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the garden as a consequential sequel assigned to a defined action-class.
topics.reason: Construct grammar and demonstrative predication support the local outcome assignment.

topics.headline: neutral word reused for both outcomes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that one consequence-word carries both garden and fire clauses, forcing the contrast onto recipients and predicates.
topics.reason: The exact repeated noun creates a binary verdict frame.

topics.headline: surah consequence keyword
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices 13:35 as the explicit binary formulation of a Surah 13 consequence thread.
topics.reason: Concrete same-surah references support this provenance.

words.gloss_range: plural relative possessor defining outcome recipients by completed action
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلَّذِينَ}} ({{tr:alladhīna}}) occupies the genitive possessor slot after {{ar:عُقْبَى}} ({{tr:ʿuqbā}}) and prepares the plural verb {{ar:ٱتَّقَوا۟}} ({{tr:ittaqaw}}). The relative form defines the outcome recipients by what they did, while its agreement reconnects them to the earlier class named {{ar:ٱلْمُتَّقُونَ}} ({{tr:al-muttaqūna}}).

topics.headline: relative action-class
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first outcome belongs to people defined by completed action, not only by a title.
topics.reason: Construct position, agreement, and relative-clause syntax support this action-class payoff.

words.gloss_range: completed collective self-guarding grounding the first outcome
words.root_gloss_range: guarding, shielding, protection, and self-protection; local Form VIII perfect selects completed reflexive self-guarding
words.prose: {{ar:ٱتَّقَوا۟}} ({{tr:ittaqaw}}) turns the earlier self-guarding identity into completed action. The perfect tense grounds the outcome in what the group has done, the plural ending makes it collective human agency, and Form VIII keeps the shielding reflexive rather than externally supplied. This closes the protection arc opened by {{ar:ٱلْمُتَّقُونَ}} ({{tr:al-muttaqūna}}) and sharpened by the denial of an outside protector in 13:34.

topics.headline: completed self-guarding action
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verdict rests on enacted self-guarding, not a static label.
topics.reason: Perfect tense and relative-clause syntax support completed action as the ground of outcome.

topics.headline: reflexive collective agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices self-directed collective protection encoded in form and suffix.
topics.reason: Form VIII and plural morphology narrow the protection field to reflexive group action.

topics.headline: identity-to-deed echo
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the root echo from word 5 to word 17 and its answer to 13:34.
topics.reason: Intra-ayah echo and boundary evidence support the broader payoff.

words.gloss_range: contrastive conjunction binding the second outcome clause to the first
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) binds the deniers’ outcome clause to the preceding self-guarders’ outcome. Because the same {{ar:عُقْبَى}} ({{tr:ʿuqbā}}) follows with a changed group, the conjunction works contrastively: it makes the fire clause a matched counterpart, not a detached afterthought.

topics.headline: contrastive coordination
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices one coordinated verdict holding two opposed outcomes in parallel.
topics.reason: Local repetition and clause structure support contrastive coordination.

words.gloss_range: the deniers’ consequence, value-neutral until fire supplies content
words.root_gloss_range: heel, following, sequel, consequence, and punishment; local repetition selects outcome assigned to the deniers
words.prose: The second {{ar:عُقْبَى}} ({{tr:ʿuqbā}}) repeats the same consequence-word but changes the possessor to {{ar:ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ}} ({{tr:al-kāfirīna}}). Here the phrase becomes the subject whose predicate is {{ar:ٱلنَّارُ}} ({{tr:al-nāru}}), so the noun does not itself mean punishment; fire supplies the negative content. The repetition keeps garden and fire inside one neutral outcome frame while identifying the unnamed punished group from 13:34, and it also joins the same-surah consequence arc around 13:32 and 13:42.

topics.headline: deniers outcome with fire predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the whole denier sequel is compressed into one subject-predicate identification.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence confirm construct subject plus fire predicate.

topics.headline: same neutral noun opposite content
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the identical outcome noun is neutral while context polarizes it.
topics.reason: Exact repetition across the two clauses supports value-neutral contrast.

topics.headline: same-surah punishment arc
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the deniers’ fire as part of a Surah 13 consequence arc around 13:32 and 13:42.
topics.reason: Concrete same-surah references support the echo.

words.gloss_range: defined denier class possessing the second outcome
words.root_gloss_range: covering, concealing, denial, ingratitude, and covering seed; local active participle selects deniers while preserving covering irony
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ}} ({{tr:al-kāfirīna}}) is genitive under the second {{ar:عُقْبَى}} ({{tr:ʿuqbā}}), so fire is assigned to a defined denier class. The article and active participle make that class enduring and recognizable. The root’s covering field is narrowed here to denial, but the seed-covering sense creates garden irony: those named by covering do not receive the sheltered garden. This also forms the ayah’s binary with {{ar:ٱلْمُتَّقُونَ}} ({{tr:al-muttaqūna}}): self-shielding versus truth-covering. As the class-name moves directly into the fire predicate, the sound tightens from the back consonant into the repeated n/r closure, matching the denial-fire field prepared earlier, including 13:5.

topics.headline: defined possessor of fire outcome
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the fire outcome is grammatically assigned to a bounded denier class.
topics.reason: Construct grammar, definiteness, and participle form support class assignment.

topics.headline: covering-root garden irony
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the irony that the cover-root deniers are excluded from the protective garden.
topics.reason: The agricultural and covering senses survive as irony, while local sense remains deniers.

topics.headline: self-shielders versus truth-coverers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the ayah’s moral antithesis as two different uses of covering or protection.
topics.reason: Parallel class nouns and root-field contrast support the binary payoff.

topics.headline: denial-fire field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the final class-name moving into the fire/light punishment field prepared earlier, including 13:5, with the sound tightening into the fire closure.
topics.reason: Co-occurrence, same-surah recurrence, and sound-row evidence preserve this provenance.

words.gloss_range: the definite fire as compressed final predicate of the deniers’ outcome
words.root_gloss_range: fire, light, radiance, exposure, and illumination; local surface selects destructive fire while retaining exposure contrast
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلنَّارُ}} ({{tr:al-nāru}}) is the definite one-word predicate of the deniers’ outcome. After the garden has been elaborated through rivers, produce, and shade, the opposing result is compressed into a known singular fire. The root family also contains light, but the surface selects destructive fire; that radiance field sharpens the contrast between sheltered garden-concealment and exposed combustion. As the final word, it makes the ayah close on stark, unelaborated fire, recalling earlier Surah 13 fire and light contexts at 13:5 and 13:17 while landing acoustically on a sustained ā and rolling r.

topics.headline: one-word fire predicate
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the deniers’ outcome compressed into a single known final noun after the expansive garden scene.
topics.reason: QAC predication, definiteness, and final-word position support this payoff.

topics.headline: fire selected within light root family
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices exposure and radiance pressure while the surface selects destructive fire, not guidance-light.
topics.reason: Root range is narrowed by the local fire noun and punishment predicate.

topics.headline: singular fire versus varied garden benefits
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices protected enclosure versus exposed fire, with singular fire opposing plural rivers and paired benefits.
topics.reason: Form and root-level contrast with the garden preserve this binary image.

topics.headline: surah echo and acoustic finality
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the closing fire as both an earlier Surah 13 punishment echo and a sustained ā-plus-r acoustic landing.
topics.reason: Concrete same-surah references and sound rows support closure provenance.

baseline_models.mechanism: The garden is a tree-covered enclosure whose lower watercourse continually supplies yield and shelter; permanence names a maintained habitat, not a frozen inventory.

activation_trace.role: A tree-screened garden literally supplies the enclosing habitat in which the other provisions operate.
Literal streaming supplies continuous movement and makes the habitat self-renewing.
A watercourse cut through earth supplies the channel beneath the garden.
Tree and crop yield supplies the recurring edible output of the habitat.
Literal persistence and settled continuity prevent the yield from entering a depletion cycle.
Shade as shelter, guard, and ease makes protection part of the habitat's output.

changed_reading.before: A static reward scene containing a garden, rivers, fruit, and shade.
changed_reading.after: A continuously maintained protective ecology whose moving water sustains unexhausted nourishment and shelter.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: مَّثَلُ ... وُعِدَ ٱلْمُتَّقُونَ ... عُقْبَى ... وَعُقْبَى ... ٱلنَّارُ
baseline_models.mechanism: The opening description and doubled outcome construction place two groups on opposed consequence paths: promised protective flourishing and fire.

activation_trace.role: A descriptive report literally frames the verse as a disclosed condition rather than an ornamental comparison alone.
A spoken commitment opens expectation and makes the garden a guaranteed prospective condition.
Putting oneself in protection identifies the disposition attached to the promised trajectory.
The ending or inherited consequence supplies the repeated hinge that pairs both destinations.
Covering or denying truth identifies the disposition attached to the contrary trajectory.
Literal kindled fire supplies the terminal condition of the second trajectory.

changed_reading.before: The verse appends punishment to a reward description.
changed_reading.after: The verse exhibits two disposition-conditioned trajectories and repeats 'outcome' to make both garden and fire consequences of a course.

baseline_models.mechanism: Flow and permanence are not opposites: water keeps moving while provision remains available, so endurance is a stable process rather than immobility.

activation_trace.role: Literal running contributes ongoing motion to the scene.
An enduring grant of provision lets the running function as sustained supply rather than mere scenery.
Persistence with settledness contributes stable availability across the water's motion.
Recurring yield is the output whose availability does not fail.
Continuous cover supplies the second nondepleting output alongside food.

changed_reading.before: 'Permanent' means that the scene simply lasts forever.
changed_reading.after: Permanence is dynamic reliability: movement continues, but nourishment and cover never lapse.

baseline_models.mechanism: The focus repeatedly varies covering: garden and shade cover beneficially, taqwa seeks a shield, kufr covers culpably, and the final fire both burns and emits light. The contrast is therefore protected cover versus truth-covering that ends in exposure, not simply light versus dark.

activation_trace.role: Literal concealment supplies the garden's beneficent enclosure.
A barrier against harm supplies the protective logic of taqwa.
Shadow literally covers from exposure and reinforces beneficent concealment.
Literal covering supplies the opposed act of concealing rather than receiving truth.
Illumination within the fire root makes the terminal fire an exploratory image of forced exposure.
The actual kindled fire keeps that exposure image anchored in the verse's explicit destination.

changed_reading.before: Garden and shade are bright reward imagery, while fire is only dark punishment imagery.
changed_reading.after: The verse contrasts protective concealment with culpable concealment that culminates in a burning, illuminating exposure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same running image serves bodies moving toward a named term in 13:2 and rivers paired with lasting yield in 13:35. The repeated motion makes the garden's continuity exceptional rather than generic duration.

activation_trace.role: Literal running carries the celestial bodies along a bounded course and supplies the finite comparator.
A fixed temporal limit terminates that comparator's running.
An enduring provision converts the focus river's running into maintained supply.
Persistence explicitly marks the focus provision as nonexpiring.

structural_cues: 13:2 binds every runner to a named term; 13:35 binds running to lasting produce and shade.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies one bounded and one provision-bearing use of running; I infer finite course -> contrastive nondepletion, while the live alternative is that the two motions are merely analogous signs.

changed_reading.before: The rivers are one timeless feature of the garden.
changed_reading.after: Their continued running answers a surah-wide world of courses that normally reach a limit: motion remains, depletion does not.

context_deltas.mechanism: Adjacent plots receive one irrigation source yet produce ranked yields. This sharpens the focus garden from generic abundance into a perfectly sustained transformation of shared water into distinctive nourishment.

activation_trace.role: An allotted irrigation channel literally supplies the distribution mechanism among plots.
Ordinary water supplies the common material input.
Numerical oneness makes that material input shared rather than separately tailored.
Difference in rank supplies the divergent quality of outputs from one input.
Crop yield is the measured output in which differentiation appears.
The focus yield becomes the perfected, continuously available output of that irrigation logic.
Permanence removes the fluctuation that affects ordinary cultivated outputs.

structural_cues: 13:4 sequences adjacent parcels -> one water -> differentiated produce; 13:35 sequences lower rivers -> lasting produce.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies shared irrigation and unequal yield; I infer input -> transformed output as the focus habitat's causal ecology, while an alternative reads 13:4 only as an independent sign of creative power.

changed_reading.after: It promises an ecology whose common water is unfailingly converted into fitting, differentiated nourishment.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier exemplary punishments and severe punishment activate the punitive-exemplar branch of the focus opening. Its 'description' can therefore also function as an exhibited consequence meant to redirect conduct.

activation_trace.role: Punitive exempla literally supply consequences made into warnings for others.
Punishment after wrongdoing supplies the causal edge behind those warning examples.
The focus's descriptive report remains the grammatical base while taking on an exemplary function.
Two explicit endings make the displayed garden and fire behaviorally consequential.

structural_cues: 13:6 couples past exempla with severe punishment; 13:35 opens with a description and closes by naming both outcomes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a punitive exemplar and two focus outcomes; I infer displayed consequence -> present admonitory force, while the alternative keeps focus mathal purely descriptive.

changed_reading.before: 'The description of the garden' introduces neutral information.
changed_reading.after: The description is also a live exemplary display: its paired outcomes are shown so the hearer can change course.

context_deltas.mechanism: The root of outcome first appears as successive attendants guarding a person, while later every soul's acquisition is tracked and the surah asks whose outcome the home will be. Outcome becomes the accumulated rear edge of a guarded, changeable course.

activation_trace.role: One thing following another literally supplies succession along the person's course.
Guarding and watch supply continuous oversight within that succession.
Acquiring a gain supplies the person's own accumulating contribution to the course.
Repeated acquisition makes the terminal outcome answer to an ongoing history rather than a static label.
The final consequence of the home supplies the explicit terminus of that history.
The focus's doubled endings become two possible termini of an accumulated course.

structural_cues: 13:11 places successive guardians before and behind and then states that change begins within people; 13:42 asks whose outcome the home is.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies succession, guarding, self-change, acquisition, and final outcome; I infer tracked course -> accrued terminus, while the alternative treats the repeated root as loose wordplay without causal continuity.

changed_reading.before: The two outcomes are fixed labels attached to two classes.
changed_reading.after: Each outcome is the trailing consequence of a watched but internally changeable course whose acts accumulate into a home.

context_deltas.mechanism: The failed image of outstretched palms unable to bring water to the mouth makes access, not mere water-presence, decisive. The focus's under-running rivers become provision already routed to its recipients.

activation_trace.role: An extended hand literally supplies effort directed toward inaccessible water.
The palms supply the bodily receptacle that nevertheless cannot secure the provision.
Literal water supplies the desired but unreached object.
Arrival at a goal is explicitly negated and supplies the failed delivery mechanism.
Running beneath the garden supplies a routed, proximate water movement.
A cut watercourse supplies reliable conveyance rather than unreachable standing water.

structural_cues: 13:14's simile denies water-to-mouth arrival; 13:35 locates flowing channels beneath the promised habitat.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed reach and proximate channels; I infer routed water -> fulfilled access, while the alternative limits 13:14 to failed invocation with no material contrast.

changed_reading.after: Its water is effective provision: already channeled within reach, in contrast to desired water that never arrives.

context_deltas.mechanism: Shadows elsewhere participate in submission at morning and evening. The focus shadow can therefore be carried not only as comfort but as an uninterrupted creaturely alignment whose ordinary temporal oscillation has become perpetual shelter.

activation_trace.role: Cast shadow literally supplies the nonhuman participant in the submission scene.
Morning supplies one temporal pole of the shadow's repeated movement.
Late day supplies the other temporal pole of that repeated movement.
The focus shadow retains literal cover while receiving the context's active temporal resonance.
Perpetuity turns morning-evening recurrence into unbroken availability and, exploratorily, unbroken alignment.

structural_cues: 13:15 coordinates shadows with willing or unwilling prostration and marks morning/evening; 13:35 coordinates shade with permanence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies submitting shadows and perpetual focus shade; I infer temporal participation -> uninterrupted alignment, while the live alternative is that the focus shade carries comfort only.

changed_reading.before: Perpetual shade is passive climatic comfort.
changed_reading.after: It can also image shelter continuously aligned with the created order, a strange but text-anchored activation from the submitting shadows.

context_deltas.mechanism: The water/fire parable separates rising foam that departs from benefit that remains. Because the focus again joins example, water, permanence, useful yield, and fire, its two outcomes can be read as the endpoints of a retention filter: sustaining benefit versus consuming exposure.

activation_trace.role: Flood-flow literally supplies the moving carrier in the sorting process.
Floating foam supplies the conspicuous but removable layer.
Kindled fire supplies the second material process that exposes and separates.
A struck parable explicitly classifies the water/fire sequence as an image meant to be transferred.
Benefit opposed to harm supplies the criterion for what deserves retention.
Remaining with patient stability supplies the durable result of the filter.
The focus opening invites transfer of the earlier parabolic mechanism into this paired scene.
Lasting yield and shade instantiate the retained side of the process.
Kindled fire instantiates the contrary terminal condition without erasing its literal punitive force.

structural_cues: 13:17 sequences water/fire -> foam -> departure versus benefit -> remaining; 13:35 sequences example -> water -> lasting provision versus fire.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two tightly matching material constellations; I infer sorting process -> paired durable endpoints, while an alternative treats 13:35 as reward/punishment with no retained-process echo.

changed_reading.before: Garden and fire are two externally assigned destinations.
changed_reading.after: They also render the two termini of a demonstrated filter: what nourishes and remains becomes habitat, while the contrary course ends in fire.

context_deltas.mechanism: The good outcome is generated by keeping covenant, maintaining connection, patience, entry with repaired kin, open gates, and peace; the bad home follows severance and corruption. The focus garden is therefore a socially connected dwelling, not private consumption.

activation_trace.role: Full completion without deficiency supplies covenant performance as a maintained practice.
A preserved compact supplies the durable relational bond being performed.
Continuing connection and refusing estrangement supply the social mechanism leading toward the good home.
Holding the self against collapse supplies temporal endurance within that mechanism.
The resulting end of the dwelling explicitly names connection's destination.
Literal entry supplies admission of both recipients and arriving messengers into a shared interior.
Multiple entrances supply permeability and welcome rather than isolation.
Safety from harm supplies the social atmosphere announced at arrival.
Severing connection supplies the inverse mechanism leading to the bad home.
Departure from sound order supplies the environmental and social result of severance.
The focus garden becomes the habitat in which the repaired relational network dwells.

structural_cues: Branchless 13:22 د ر ء at word 13 is used only structurally: bad is repelled with good before 'outcome of the home'.
13:23 includes parents, spouses, descendants, and entry through every gate; 13:25 reverses connection into cutting and corruption.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies kept bonds, repaired kinship, entry, peace, and their severing inverse; I infer relational maintenance -> habitable outcome, while an alternative treats these as qualifications for an otherwise individual reward.

changed_reading.before: The promised garden rewards each pious individual with food and shade.
changed_reading.after: It is the durable household-form of maintained connection: repaired generations share entry, peace, provision, and shelter, while severance produces the contrary home.

context_deltas.mechanism: Worldly provision expands and contracts, and worldly life is usable enjoyment that reaches a limit. Lasting produce and shade answer both instabilities: the focus promises reliable sufficiency rather than simply a larger quantity.

activation_trace.role: Expansion and abundance supply one pole of worldly provision's fluctuation.
An allotted gift supplies the worldly distribution being expanded or restricted.
Constriction to a narrow measure supplies the opposite pole of fluctuation.
Enjoyment extending only to its limit supplies the temporal inadequacy of worldly provision.
A nourishing share supplies the focus's directly available provision.
Persistence removes both contraction and terminal expiry from that share.

structural_cues: 13:26 opposes expansion to restriction and present life to the hereafter; 13:35 foregrounds lasting yield and shade.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies variable allotment and limited enjoyment; I infer volatility/limit -> contrastive reliability, while the alternative hears only a quantitative contrast between little and much.

changed_reading.after: It means provision freed from both scarcity cycles and expiry: dependable sufficiency is the promise's distinctive good.

context_deltas.mechanism: Tranquil hearts supply an interior analogue for the focus's paradox of running water and settled permanence. The garden can image a stable state maintained through ongoing movement, not calm achieved by stopping movement.

activation_trace.role: Literal settling and tranquility supply the interior state to be compared with stable provision.
The heart supplies the interior location in which that settledness occurs.
Repeated recollection supplies the ongoing activity that maintains tranquility.
Continuous running supplies the outer ecology's ongoing activity.
Settled persistence supplies the stable condition produced alongside that activity.

structural_cues: 13:28 repeats tranquility and remembrance; 13:35 juxtaposes running with settled permanence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies active remembrance with settled hearts and active flow with lasting provision; I infer repeated activity -> maintained stability, while an alternative keeps the psychological and ecological images separate.

changed_reading.before: Garden movement is external scenery and permanence is only duration.
changed_reading.after: The habitat models dynamic repose: continuous circulation maintains a settled outer and, analogically, inner condition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The promise is said to arrive without breach after an interval in which deniers are given time, then punishment follows. The focus passive 'was promised' therefore carries appointment-through-delay, and its permanence begins after rather than abolishes temporal waiting.

activation_trace.role: A binding promise supplies certainty despite its not-yet arrival.
An appointed time supplies the promise's bounded point of fulfillment.
Extended time and respite supply the experienced delay before consequence.
Punishment following wrongdoing supplies one realized side of delayed consequence.
The passive focus promise receives the context's certainty-through-waiting.
Lasting provision describes the post-fulfillment condition rather than the waiting interval.

structural_cues: 13:31 says the promise comes and the appointment is not broken; 13:32 inserts respite before seizure; 13:35 uses a passive completed promise.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies appointment, nonbreach, respite, and consequence; I infer delayed commitment -> certain fulfillment -> lasting state, while an alternative treats the delay material as relevant only to punishment.

changed_reading.before: The promised garden is presented as immediately available timeless fact.
changed_reading.after: It is an appointed fulfillment whose certainty survives delay; once reached, its provision no longer shares the delay-and-expiry pattern.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus and again after it, no protector exists against God; in the focus the promised group is named by self-protective taqwa. The reversal blocks a self-sufficient reading of piety and relocates protection inside the promised divine order.

activation_trace.role: A protector who interposes against harm is explicitly absent and supplies the immediate negative frame.
The repeated absence of a protector confirms that no external shield can oppose divine consequence.
Reflexively placing oneself in protection supplies the recipients' posture, not an independent protector.
A protective shield within the garden root makes the promised habitat itself an image of granted protection.
Shelter, guard, and ease supply the concrete condition into which that posture leads.

structural_cues: 13:34's 'no protector' directly precedes 13:35's muttaqun/ittaqaw pair; 13:37 repeats 'no protector'.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies denied external protection and promised self-protective people; I infer failed autonomous shield -> receptive protective posture -> granted shelter, while an alternative reads only a lexical contrast between sinners and pious people.

changed_reading.before: The pious protect themselves and are rewarded with a protected garden.
changed_reading.after: Taqwa is not leverage or an independent shield; it is the posture associated with entering the only effective protection, represented by enclosure and shade.

context_deltas.mechanism: Every term has an inscribed determination, marks may be erased or established, and present land diminishes; yet judgment admits no reversing reviewer and the final outcome of the home remains. Focus permanence belongs beyond the field of present mutability, not as its endless extension.

activation_trace.role: A fixed temporal limit supplies the boundary governing each present course.
An inscription that establishes decree supplies ordered determination for each limit.
Removal of an effect supplies one side of the mutable record.
Endurance and fixation supply the opposed act of establishing what remains.
Loss of part of a thing supplies visible diminishment in the present land.
The denied reviewer or reverser supplies the irreversibility of judgment despite prior mutability.
The final consequence of the home supplies the settled endpoint after changing records and shrinking land.
Unbroken persistence marks the focus provision as belonging to that settled endpoint.

structural_cues: 13:38-39 moves from term and book to erasure/establishment; 13:41-42 moves from diminishing edges and irreversible judgment to the outcome of the home.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies bounded time, mutable inscription, diminishment, and irreversible outcome; I infer mutable present -> settled judgment -> nondepleting habitat, while an alternative reads these only as separate demonstrations of sovereignty.

changed_reading.before: The hereafter extends ideal earthly resources forever.
changed_reading.after: Its lasting produce and shade mark a categorical transition out of the present order of limits, revision, and diminishment into an irreversible outcome.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant split mappings of و ع د to preparation/counting and swimming/yearly cycling. It remains anchored at the focus promise and visibly converges with prepared provision, rivers, and permanence, but downstream prose should present it only as a form-distant material echo, never as the lexical derivation of وُعِدَ.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: وُعِدَ at 13:35[4], beside running rivers and lasting yield

activation_trace.role: Prepared stores and equipment literally supply an echo of provision made ready before arrival.
A perennial collected water source supplies a material echo of the garden's nonfailing rivers.
Swimming or current-like motion supplies an echo of water continuously running beneath the habitat.
Alternating annual palm yield supplies a foil whose cycle the focus's lasting yield overcomes.

changed_reading.before: The promise is only a speech act guaranteeing a future garden.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the split-root field lets the promise resonate as provision already prepared, watered, and released from ordinary annual intermittence.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries the non-dominant ك ل ل mapping inside focus أُكُل beyond ordinary yield. It remains anchored by the verse's joint produce-and-shade construction and the branches of totality and encircling cover, but it should be rendered as a secondary sound/form activation, not as replacement morphology for أُكُل.

activation_trace.role: Wholeness that gathers all parts supplies an exploratory sense of provision without missing components.
An encircling crown, cloud, or flower-ring supplies an exploratory spatial link from yield to surrounding canopy.
An overhead canopy keeps the encircling reading visibly attached to the stated shade.

changed_reading.before: Produce and shade are two separate amenities.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they form complete provision around the inhabitant: nourishment as output and canopy as an encircling whole.

strongest_changes: The 13:17 water/fire filter changes garden and fire from a bare destination pair into retained benefit versus consuming exposure.
The 13:20-25 covenant sequence changes the garden from private reward into a connected, intergenerational home generated by maintained bonds.
The immediate 'no protector' / muttaqun reversal changes taqwa from self-sufficient shielding into a posture associated with granted protection.
Worldly expansion, contraction, limits, erasure, and diminishment make lasting produce dependable and categorically post-mutable rather than merely abundant.
summary.what_was_special: The focus condenses the surah's repeated material grammar: flowing versus expiring courses, one water becoming differentiated yield, foam departing while benefit remains, connection becoming a home, and protection denied outside the order that grants shelter. Split mapped roots also preserve two contained echoes: promise as prepared/perennial provision and yield as complete encircling provision.
remaining_uncertainties: The active-submitting force of perpetual shade is well anchored by 13:15 but may remain only a contextual resonance, not a semantic component of the focus noun.
The covering/exposure axis crosses moral valuations and should not collapse garden, kufr, shade, and fire into one undifferentiated metaphor.
The two split-root outliers are deliberately form-distant and must remain exploratory rather than become lexical claims.
The water/fire retention model is structurally strong, but the direction from the earlier parable to the focus's final destinations remains reader-supplied.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. `د و م/B001` is stable continuance, including lasting rain and shade. Continuous fruit, shade, and rivers reactivate 13:4 and 17. I infer a regenerative system in which flow sustains yield without exhaustion; `دَائِمٌ` is productive continuity, not frozen sameness.
2. `ظ ل ل/B001` is covering shade. Against moving shadows in 13:15, I infer stabilized fulfillment: cyclical submission becomes enduring shelter.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: No later ecological image surpassed this synthesis; 13:39 only added a structural analogue of stable source beneath changing traces.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **The good outcome is an ecology of uninterrupted supply.** `ج ر ي / B001` is running and flowing, `د و م / B001` is stable remaining and continuance, `ظ ل ل / B001` is shade as covering, and `ع ق ب / B006` is the end and outcome. Rivers move while food and shade remain; the combination makes permanence depend not on immobility but on continuously renewed provision. Nearby 13:31-32 contrast recurring impacts with an appointed end, 13:34 activates punishment as withholding without a barrier, and 13:38-39 place terms, writing, erasure, and confirmation around the promise. I assign flow the role of renewal, food the role of nourishment, and shade the role of protective continuity. The packet supplies moving source plus stable benefits; I infer uninterrupted renewal -> enduring habitation. The garden reads as a maintained ecology, sharply opposed to fire as the alternative outcome.

2. **Protective caution and protection belong to one causal loop.** `و ق ي / B002` is placing the self in protective caution and `و ق ي / B001` is warding harm off with a barrier. The root appears in the promised recipients and again in their prior action, while 13:34 and 13:37 deny a `واق` to the opposed trajectory. I assign self-protective caution the role of choosing the protected course and the garden's shade the role of its environmental completion. The packet supplies both action and outcome; I infer maintained caution -> entry into sustained protection. This does not make the garden self-earned; it makes the lexical relation between conduct and promised shelter visible.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 13:38-40 placed promise, term, book, erasure/confirmation, and partial visibility around the garden. That later administrative sequence made its permanence read as continuously maintained provision under ordered governance, not as a scene outside all process.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Orientation depends on a traversable route whose guide and markers can be opposed by barriers and diversion.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Guidance becomes road engineering: route, leading figure, beacon, barrier, and deviation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Route, Leader, and Beacon
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A clear road is marked and entered behind a guide or leading point.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: extended traversable road (`quranic:root_000672:B001/m01`); gentle guidance toward road and truth (`quranic:root_001583:B001/m01`); leader or foremost part that guides (`quranic:root_001583:B003/m01`); clear road across easy ground (`quranic:root_001464:B007/m01`); beacon or waymark (`quranic:root_001564:B005/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 13:33 `السَّبِيل` (س ب ل), `هَاد` (ه د ي), and `تُنَبِّئُونَه` (ن ب ء); 13:35 `النَّار` (ن و ر).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Road, leading figure, easy ground, and beacon make guidance a concrete route scene. The path is legible because its direction is embodied in marks and a forerunner.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A protected planted enclosure is continuously supplied, yields food, and remains as the favorable end.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Irrigation, canopy, duration, and final consequence form one sustained habitat.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Flowing Water, Yield, and Shade
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Rivers feed a tree-covered enclosure whose yield and overhead cover remain available.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: tree-covered garden (`quranic:root_000266:B003/m01`); flowing current (`quranic:root_000240:B001/m01`); river cut through earth (`quranic:root_001559:B001/m01`); crop and tree yield (`quranic:root_000043:B002/m01`); sheltering shade (`quranic:root_000966:B001/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 13:35 `الجَنَّة` (ج ن ن), `تَجْرِي` (ج ر ي), `الأَنْهَار` (ن ه ر), `أُكُلُهَا` (ء ك ل), and `ظِلُّهَا` (ظ ل ل).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Enclosure, current, channel, yield, and shade create a functioning garden rather than a list of amenities. Continuous supply explains the persistence of both food and cover.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A protected planted enclosure is continuously supplied, yields food, and remains as the favorable end.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Irrigation, canopy, duration, and final consequence form one sustained habitat.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Lasting Station and Contrasted End
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: The supplied garden remains fixed as one outcome, while fire forms the opposed outcome.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: duration and stable continuation (`quranic:root_000501:B001/m01`); persistence against removal (`quranic:root_000192:B001/m01`); resulting end (`quranic:root_001033:B006/m01`); promise opening expectation (`quranic:root_001662:B001/m01`); burning fire (`quranic:root_001564:B002/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.ayah_anchors: 13:35 `دَائِم` (د و م), `وُعِد` (و ع د), `عُقْبَى` (ع ق ب), and `النَّار` (ن و ر); 13:39 `يُثْبِت` (ث ب ت).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Duration, fixedness, promise, and outcome explain why the garden is a station rather than a passing scene. Fire is not another garden component but the terminal contrast that defines the favorable end.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P3 - Decorated Plot and Concealed Spoilage
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: An attractive exterior can be applied as a coating while corruption persists beneath it.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Cosmetic pigment, covering, and spoiled fruit provide a material anatomy for self-deception.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Spoiled Interior and Denial
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Beneath the improved surface, food or material decays while the subject refuses recognition.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: spoiled date or moist fruit (`quranic:root_001438:B006/m01`); consumption turning to bodily or material corruption (`quranic:root_000043:B006/m01`); denial contrary to recognition (`quranic:root_001550:B001/m01`); inward inclination and desire (`quranic:root_001609:B004/m01`).
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: Spoilage, corrosive consumption, denial, and desire supply the hidden state beneath the decorated plot. The channel pressures attractive scheming by exposing it as cosmetic treatment over decay.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, iki şey arasındaki benzerlik, denklik ve birbirine örnek oluşturma ilişkisini ortak çekirdek olarak açıkça kurar. Verilen dal çerçevesi bu genel karşılaştırma anlamını doğru yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal, kalıplaşmış özlü sözü, cezalandırmayı, betimlemeyi veya yapılmış görüntüyü değil, iki şey arasındaki genel benzerlik ve denklik ilişkisini anlatır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal hem ad ve sıfat niteliğindeki biçimleri hem de bir şeyi başka bir şeye benzetme eylemini içerir; eyleme özgü katılımcı yapısı bütün dala yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin başka bir şeye benzer, denk veya onunla aynı ölçüde sayılması; ayrıca bir şeyi başka bir şeye benzetme eylemidir.

facets.statement: İki şey arasında benzerlik, denklik veya eşitlik ilişkisi kurulur; eylem kullanımında bu ilişki konuşan tarafından açıkça kurulabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, çekirdeği bir şeyin başka bir şeye benzemesi, onun dengi olması veya onunla eşit sayılması olarak ortaklaşa verir; ayrıca benzetme eylemini de aynı ilişkiye bağlar.

concept_gloss.applicability: İki şey arasındaki genel benzerlik veya eşitlik ilişkisini, gerektiğinde bu ilişkiyi kurma eylemiyle birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Genel benzerlik, denklik ve karşılaştırma çekirdeğinin tümünü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir varlığın başka bir varlıkla benzer veya eşdeğer sayıldığı ad ve sıfat bağlamlarında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Belirli iki şey arasındaki benzerlik ve denklik ilişkisini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin bir şeyi başka bir şeye benzer gösterdiği eylem bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Benzetme ilişkisinin etkin biçimde kurulmasını ve iki tarafını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, genel eşitlik ve denklik bağıntısını açıkça kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, biçim ve görünüş uyumunun yanında tür, çift ve sınıf birliklerini de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da iki şey arasında benzerlik ve uygunluk bulunduğunu anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın çekirdeği genel benzerlik ve denkliğe dayanır; komşu dal ise özellikle biçimsel uyumu ve aynı türden ya da eşleşen öğeler olmayı daha geniş biçimde içerir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar karşılaştırıldı; genel benzerlikle en kolay karışan biçimsel ve türsel uyuşma adayı sınırı en açık biçimde gösterdiği için yayımlandı.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, bir kimseye ağır ve ibret verici biçimde davranmayı, onu başkalarını caydıracak bir örnek durumuna getirmeyi ve bazı kullanımlarda yaralama ya da karşılık olarak öldürmeyi birlikte doğrular. Verilen dal kimliği bu yaptırım çekirdeğini korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu anlam sıradan benzerlikten ayrılır; cezalandırılan kişinin uğradığı işlem başkalarını caydıran görünür bir sonuç doğurur.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal, cezalandırma adlarını ve belirli tümleçlerle kurulan cezalandırma, yaralama ve karşılık verme yapılarını içerir; yapıya bağlı ayrıntılar yalın kök anlamı sayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir kimseye ağır, yaralayıcı veya karşılık niteliğinde bir ceza uygulayıp onu başkalarının sakınacağı ibret verici bir duruma getirmektir.

facets.statement: Cezalandırılan kişiye yapılan ağır işlem, yalnız ona karşı bir yaptırım değil, başkalarını da caydıran ibret verici bir sonuçtur.
Özel yapılarda eylem, öldürülen kişinin bedenini kesip bozmayı, karşılık olarak öldürmeyi veya birinden öç alır gibi hakkını almayı anlatabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar ağır cezalandırma ile başkalarını caydıracak ibret oluşturma bağını ortaklaştırır; bazı biçimler bedenin kesilip bozulmasına, karşılık olarak öldürmeye ve hakkın karşılığını almaya özelleşir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Ağır işlemin hem cezalandırılan kişiye yöneldiğini hem de başkalarını caydıran bir örnek sonuç doğurduğunu birlikte anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Ağır yaptırım, ibret oluşturma ve caydırma sonuçlarının tümünü korur.

contextual_glosses.text: onu ibret olsun diye ağır biçimde cezalandırdı
contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişiye uygulanan yaptırımın başkalarını da sakındırması amaçlandığında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yaptırımın hedefini, ağırlığını ve başkalarına dönük caydırıcı sonucunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Yetkili birinin suçun karşılığını uyguladığı veya bir kişinin hakkının karşılığını aldığı özel yapılarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Karşılık verme ve cezalandırma yönlerini birlikte korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, bedeni kesip bozma ve suça denk karşılık verme gibi özel uygulamaları da içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, failin yeniden aynı işi yapmasını önleme sonucunu açıkça çekirdeğe alır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda bir kişiye verilen ceza, hem onu hem de olayı gören başkalarını sakındırır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal cezalandırılanı görünür bir ibret durumuna getiren ağır işlemi ve bazı özel karşılık türlerini kapsar; komşu dalın odağı ise cezayla tekrarın önlenmesi ve başkalarının korkutulmasıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; caydırıcı cezalandırma adayı çekirdekle en güçlü örtüşmeyi gösterirken bedeni bozma ve suça denk karşılık sınırlarını da görünür kıldığı için seçildi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه التنكيل والجدع والعقوبة والقصاص وجعل المعاقب مثالا يرتدع به غيره
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس مجرد المشابهة ولا المثل المضروب
branches.source_phrase_ar: مثل به إذا نكل (maqayis); مثلت بالرجل إذا نكلت به (jamhara); مثل به يمثل مثلا أي نكل به (sihah); المثلة الاسم (tahdhib); نقمة تنزل بالإنسان فيجعل مثالا يرتدع به غيره (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, başka bir durumla benzerliği üzerinden aktarılan kalıplaşmış veya örnek niteliğindeki sözü, böyle bir sözü söylemeyi ve bir şiir dizesini bu amaçla anmayı birlikte doğrular. Dal çerçevesi bu sözlü kullanım alanını doğru ayırır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal iki şeyin yalnızca benzemesini değil, bir durumu başka bir durum üzerinden anlatmak için söylenen ve dolaşım kazanan sözü kapsar.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal, özlü örnek sözün adını ve onu söyleme ya da bir dizeyle örneklendirme yapılarını ayırır; eylem kalıpları yalın adın bütün kullanımlarına taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir durumdaki anlamı benzer başka bir duruma taşıyan, örnek olarak söylenen ve çoğu kez dilden dile dolaşan özlü sözdür; böyle bir sözü veya şiir dizesini örnek diye anma eylemini de kapsar.

facets.statement: Bir şey hakkında söylenen söz, benzer bir başka durumu açıklamak için örnek söz olarak aktarılır ve kalıplaşarak dolaşıma girebilir.
Konuşan, bir örnek sözü söyleyebilir veya bir şiir dizesini aynı işlevle anarak kendi durumuna dayanak yapabilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, benzer iki durum arasında anlam taşıyan ve örnek olarak söylenen söz çekirdeğinde birleşir; dolaşımda olan özlü söz, böyle bir söz söyleme ve bir dizeyi örnek gösterme kullanımları bu çekirdeğe bağlanır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir durumun anlamını benzer başka bir durum üzerinden açıklayan özlü sözün kendisini ve onu örnek diye anma kullanımını kapsar.

error_profile.preserves: Söz olma, benzer durumlar arasında anlam taşıma ve örnek gösterilme özelliklerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bilinen ve sıkça tekrarlanan kalıplaşmış örnek sözlerden bahsedilen bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sözün kalıplaşmış ve yaygın biçimde dolaşan niteliğini korur.
error_profile.loses: Henüz yaygınlaşmamış örnek sözleri ve bir dizeyi örnek diye anma eylemini dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir şiir dizesinin mevcut durumu açıklamak veya desteklemek için anıldığı bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Şiir dizesini benzer bir duruma örnek olarak aktarma işlevini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: benzer bir duruma aktarılan örnek söz

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, kalıplaşmış sözün kendisini ve bir dizeyi örnek diye aktarmayı kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, bir anlatımı betimleme ve açıklama yoluyla görünür kılma eylemini öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalda bir durum, başka bir anlatım veya örnek aracılığıyla anlaşılır kılınır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın merkezinde benzer durumlara aktarılabilen özlü söz bulunur; komşu dalın merkezinde ise sözün kalıplaşmış olması değil, betimleme ve açıklama eylemi vardır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar incelendi; belirli özlü sözler yalnız örnek düzeyinde kaldı, açıklayıcı betimleme adayı ise sözün kendisi ile anlatma eylemi arasındaki sınırı en iyi gösterdi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه القول المضروب مثلا والمثل السائر والتمثل بالبيت وضرب الأمثال
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس النظير المجرد ولا الصفة الخالصة ولا التمثال المصور
branches.source_phrase_ar: المثل المضروب (maqayis); المثل السائر (jamhara); ما يضرب به من الأمثال (sihah); يقال تمثل فلان إذا ضرب مثلا (tahdhib); عبارة عن قول في شيء يشبه قولا في شيء آخر (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, ele alınan biçimin bir şeyin niteliğini veya onun hakkında verilen bilgiyi bildirdiğini açıkça söyler. Dal çerçevesi bunu örnek söz ve yapılmış görüntü anlamlarından doğru biçimde ayırır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Burada söz konusu olan, bir şeyi anlatan nitelik ya da onun hakkındaki bilgidir; benzerlik kuran örnek söz veya görsel biçim değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın biçim doğrudan bir şeyin niteliği veya onun hakkında verilen bilgi anlamındadır; başka dallardaki kalıplı söyleme ve görüntüleme kullanımları tanıma katılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyin nasıl olduğunu bildiren nitelik veya o şey hakkında verilen bilgidir.

facets.statement: Bir varlığın niteliği dile getirilir ya da o varlık hakkında açıklayıcı bilgi verilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, yalın biçimin bir şeyin niteliğini ve onun hakkında verilen bilgiyi karşılayabildiği konusunda birleşir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir şeyin nasıl olduğunu belirten özellik ile o şey hakkında aktarılan bilgiyi birlikte kapsar.

error_profile.preserves: Nitelik bildirme ve bir şey hakkında bilgi verme yönlerinin ikisini de korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir varlığın özelliğinin veya durumunun belirtildiği bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir şeyin nasıl olduğunu bildiren nitelik yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: O şey hakkında verilen daha geniş bilgi veya haber yönünü dışarıda bırakır.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir şeyin niteliğiyle sınırlı olmayan açıklayıcı bilginin aktarıldığı bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Bir varlık hakkında açıklayıcı bilgi verme yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Tek başına özellik bildiren daha dar nitelik kullanımını açıkça belirtmez.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, bir şey hakkında verilen bilgiyi de doğrudan adlandırabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, betimleme eylemini, bir niteliği taşıma durumunu ve dil bilgisindeki niteleyici öğeyi de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir varlığın nasıl olduğunu belirten nitelik alanında buluşur.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal nitelik ile bir şey hakkındaki bilgiyi adlandırır; komşu dal ise betimleme eylemine, niteliği taşıma durumuna ve özel dil bilgisi kullanımına kadar uzanır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; nitelik alanını en geniş biçimde paylaşan komşu, bilgi bildirme ile betimleme eylemi arasındaki sınırı en yararlı biçimde gösterdi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه استعمال المثل بمعنى الصفة والخبر عن الشيء
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس ضرب المثل للتشبيه ولا الصورة المصنوعة
branches.source_phrase_ar: مثل الشيء صفته (sihah); مثلها هو الخبر عنها (tahdhib); مثلها صفتها (tahdhib); يعبر بهما عن وصف الشيء (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi sürekli olarak kişinin ayağa kalkıp dikilmesini, birinin önünde ayakta durmasını ve bu durumda bulunan kişiyi anlatır. Verilen dal kimliği bu bedensel duruş çekirdeğini doğru yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal, ayakta ve dik durumda bulunmayı anlatır; yerden ayrılıp gitme, yere sinme veya yalnızca bir yerde hazır bulunma anlamı değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Dal, kişinin ayakta dikilmesini bildiren yapı ile ayakta duran kişiyi belirten biçimi birlikte içerir; yapıdaki kişi ve duruş ayrıntısı diğer kök dallarına taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişinin ayağa kalkıp dik biçimde durması veya bu durumda ayakta duran kişi olmasıdır.

facets.statement: Kişi bedeni dik ve ayakta olacak biçimde doğrulur ya da bu duruşunu sürdürür.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, kişinin doğrulup ayakta ve dik biçimde durması çekirdeğinde birleşir; aynı kökten gelen kişi adı da bu duruşta bulunanı gösterir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bir kişinin doğrularak ayakta ve dik konuma gelmesini veya o konumda bulunmasını karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Doğrulma, ayakta bulunma ve dik duruş özelliklerinin tümünü korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin başka birinin önünde ayakta ve dik duruma geçtiği bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişinin doğrulmasını, ayakta durmasını ve konumsal ilişkisini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, özellikle kişinin doğrulup ayakta dik durmasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, yerde veya başka bir şey üzerinde sabit kalmayı ve sıkıca yapışmayı da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da dik veya yerinde sabit bir duruşu anlatabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal insanın ayağa kalkmış dik duruşuna bağlıdır; komşu dal ise daha geniş biçimde dikilme, zeminde sabitlenme ve sıkıca bağlı kalma anlamlarını içerir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar karşılaştırıldı; genel dikilme ve sabit durma adayı, odak dalın kişiye ve ayakta duruşa bağlı dar sınırını en açık biçimde gösterdi.

branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الزوال ولا اللطوء بالأرض ولا التمثال المصور
branches.source_phrase_ar: مثل الرجل قائما انتصب (maqayis); مثل الرجل مثولا إذا انتصب قائما (jamhara); مثل بين يديه مثولا أي انتصب قائما (sihah); الماثل القائم (tahdhib); أصل المثول الانتصاب (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yerinden ayrılıp gitme ile yere sinme veya izi silinmiş olma kullanımlarını aynı dalda toplar ve bunlardan birini dik durma anlamının karşıtı olarak sunar. Dal korunabilir, ancak bu kullanımlar tek bir fiziksel hareket gibi birleştirilmemelidir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, birbirine eşit olmayan iki eski kullanımı yan yana taşır: yerinden ayrılıp gitmek ile yere sinmek veya silinip belirsizleşmek.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yerinden ayrılma belirli bir tümleçli yapıda, yere sinmiş veya silinmiş olma ise kişi biçiminde görülür; bu ayrı kapsamlar tek bir yalın anlam diye genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Bir kullanımda bulunduğu yerden ayrılıp gitmek; karşıt nitelikteki başka bir kullanımda ise yere sinmek veya izi silinip belirsizleşmektir.

facets.statement: Özne bulunduğu yerden ayrılır ve oradan gider.
Karşıt bir kullanımda özne yere sinmiş, alçalmış veya izi silinerek belirsizleşmiş durumda bulunur.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynak topluluğu bir yandan yerinden ayrılıp gitmeyi, öte yandan karşıt bir kullanım olarak yere sinmeyi ve silinip belirsizleşmeyi aktarır; bu iki çizgi ayrı tutulmalıdır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın iki ayrı eski kullanımını, bunları tek bir hareket saymadan yan yana gösterir.

error_profile.preserves: Yer değiştirme ile yere sinme veya silinme kullanımlarını ayrı ayrı korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Öznenin daha önce bulunduğu yerden uzaklaştığını bildiren tümleçli yapıda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Başlangıç yerini, oradan ayrılmayı ve gitme sonucunu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Öznenin alçalmış, yere kapanmış ya da zamanla belirsizleşmiş olduğu kişi biçiminde kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yere sinme ile silinip belirsizleşme seçeneklerini korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Odak dal, karşıt bir eski kullanım olarak yere sinme ve silinip belirsizleşmeyi de taşır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Komşu dal, güneşin veya yönetimin sona ermesi ve bir şeyi yerinden kaldırma gibi daha geniş durum değişikliklerini kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir şeyin bulunduğu yerden ayrılması anlamında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın ayrılıp gitme kullanımı komşuya yaklaşır, fakat odak ayrıca yere sinme ve silinme karşıtlığını taşır; komşu ise yer ve durum değişikliğini daha geniş katılımcılarla anlatır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar incelendi; genel yer ve durum değişikliği adayı ayrılma çizgisini iyi karşılaştırdı, ancak odak dalın yere sinme ve silinme varyantını içermediği için kısmi ilişki olarak yayımlandı.
